captured.tool: recordproxy (exact bytes) in front of the lane; the requests are the validator code's own
captured.env: the 2.1-line HAPI validator lane (make validate's lane configuration, HAPI FHIR 8.10.0), local

scrub: requests are committed synthetic fixtures or bodies written for the purpose; no participant or patient data
answers are stored decoded: the client asked for gzip and the lane sent it
headers are kept only where a client reads them (Content-Type); Date, X-Request-Id, X-Powered-By, Content-Location and Location are dropped
a request answered the same way at its last repeats is kept once and marked repeat; earlier different answers are kept in order
the 2.2-line qualification the gateway runs against a default lane, run against the 2.1 lane; the lane's metadata answer is lane-2.1-metadata.json beside the validator code, not repeated here
